title: 别严士元
author: 刘长卿

Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 别严士元 — 刘长卿
春风倚棹阖闾城，水国春寒阴复晴。
细雨湿衣看不见，闲花落地听无声。
日斜江上孤帆影，草绿湖南万里情。
东道若逢相识问，青袍今日误儒生。
